The things I love

Things that feel like me

These interests are part of my everyday life, and they shape how I think and connect with people.

🎵

Music

I love finding the right song for a moment and sharing music with people close to me. A good playlist can make an ordinary day feel like a memory.

⚡

Pokémon

I can happily spend ages planning a team, trying a new strategy, or revisiting a favourite game. Pokémon brings out my playful, curious side.

🏀

Basketball

I love playing, following the game, and leading my team. Basketball pushes me to think quickly, trust other people, and keep showing up when things get tough.

A small thought for your visit.
